snorpey/jpg-glitch
https://github.com/snorpey/jpg-glitch
pin: 37822042dd41ac9692133b42699953c94261666c
MIT, Copyright (c) 2015 Georg Fischer

The glitch is glitch-canvas (same author): JPEG-encode the still, smash
bytes past the SOS marker, decode. Worker path dropped — the sandbox has
no workers. Sliders (amount, seed, iterations, quality) match
config.defaultControlParams. GifOS adds a Take photo clip and saves the
last glitch in the file. No Imgur, no share, no webcam stream.
